````typescript
export const usePatientStore = create<PatientState>()(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      currentPatientId: "PT-10492", // Default logged in as Robert Chen for immediate interactive experience
      rememberMe: true,
      patients: DEFAULT_PATIENTS,
      records: DEFAULT_RECORDS,

      login: (patientId: string) => {
        const found = get().patients.some((p) => p.id === patientId);
        if (found) {
          set({ currentPatientId: patientId });
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      },

      loginWithCredentials: (emailOrId: string) => {
        const target = emailOrId.trim().toLowerCase();
        const found = get().patients.find(
          (p) => p.id.toLowerCase() === target || p.email.toLowerCase() === target
        );
        if (found) {
          set({ currentPatientId: found.id });
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      },

      authenticatePatient: async (credentials: AuthCredentials) => {
        // Enforce a small realistic network latency to prevent timing attacks
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 450));

        const found = resolvePatientIdentifier(credentials.identifier, get().patients);
        if (!found) {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: "Invalid credentials. Please verify your Email, Username, or Patient ID and Password.",
          };
        }

        const computedHash = await hashPassword(credentials.password);
        const matchesHash =
          found.passwordHash === computedHash ||
          (found.passwordHash === DEFAULT_DEMO_HASH &&
            (credentials.password === DEFAULT_DEMO_PASSWORD || computedHash === DEFAULT_DEMO_HASH)) ||
          (!found.passwordHash && credentials.password === DEFAULT_DEMO_PASSWORD);

        if (!matchesHash) {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: "Invalid credentials. Please verify your Email, Username, or Patient ID and Password.",
          };
        }

        // If patient didn't have passwordHash saved yet, upgrade their profile
        if (!found.passwordHash) {
          get().updatePatientProfile(found.id, { passwordHash: computedHash });
        }

        set({
          currentPatientId: found.id,
          rememberMe: !!credentials.rememberMe,
        });

        return {
          success: true,
          patient: found,
        };
      },

      registerPatientAccount: async (payload: RegisterPatientPayload) => {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 550));

        const emailClean = payload.email.trim().toLowerCase();
        const usernameClean = payload.username.trim().toLowerCase();
        const state = get();

        // 1. Check duplicate email
        if (state.patients.some((p) => p.email.toLowerCase() === emailClean)) {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: "An account with this email address is already registered.",
          };
        }

        // 2. Check duplicate username
        if (
          state.patients.some(
            (p) => p.username && p.username.toLowerCase() === usernameClean
          )
        ) {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: "This username is already taken. Please choose another username.",
          };
        }

        // 3. Provider-issued Patient ID verification
        let targetPatientId = "";
        let existingPatientToAssociate: Patient | null = null;

        if (payload.patientId && payload.patientId.trim()) {
          const providerIdClean = payload.patientId.trim().toUpperCase();
          const matchExisting = state.patients.find(
            (p) => p.id.toUpperCase() === providerIdClean
          );

          if (!matchExisting) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `Provider Patient ID "${providerIdClean}" was not found in the clinic database. Leave blank to register as a new patient or contact your provider.`,
            };
          }

          // Verify if already associated with another distinct username
          if (matchExisting.username && matchExisting.username.toLowerCase() !== usernameClean) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `Patient ID "${providerIdClean}" is already linked to an existing account. Please sign in instead.`,
            };
          }

          existingPatientToAssociate = matchExisting;
          targetPatientId = matchExisting.id;
        }

        const passwordHash = await hashPassword(payload.password);

        if (existingPatientToAssociate) {
          // Link existing hospital patient record with newly created credentials
          const updatedPatient: Patient = {
            ...existingPatientToAssociate,
            name: payload.name.trim() || existingPatientToAssociate.name,
            email: emailClean,
            username: usernameClean,
            passwordHash,
          };

          set((s) => ({
            patients: s.patients.map((p) =>
              p.id === existingPatientToAssociate!.id ? updatedPatient : p
            ),
            currentPatientId: updatedPatient.id,
          }));

          return {
            success: true,
            patient: updatedPatient,
          };
        }

        // Create new patient record
        const newPatientId = `PT-${Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000)}`;
        const newPatient: Patient = {
          id: newPatientId,
          name: payload.name.trim(),
          age: 30,
          gender: "Other",
          email: emailClean,
          username: usernameClean,
          passwordHash,
          condition: "New Patient Registration",
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          hasCompletedAssessment: false,
        };

        set((s) => ({
          patients: [newPatient, ...s.patients],
          currentPatientId: newPatientId,
          records: {
            ...s.records,
            [newPatientId]: [],
          },
        }));

        return {
          success: true,
          patient: newPatient,
        };
      },

      saveHealthAssessment: (patientId, data, markComplete = true) => {
        set((state) => ({
          patients: state.patients.map((p) => {
            if (p.id !== patientId) return p;
            const updatedProfile = data.profile ? { ...p.profileData, ...data.profile } : p.profileData;
            const updatedContact = data.contact ? { ...p.contactData, ...data.contact } : p.contactData;
            const updatedEmergency = data.emergency ? { ...p.emergencyData, ...data.emergency } : p.emergencyData;
            const updatedAssessment = data.assessment ? { ...p.assessmentData, ...data.assessment } : p.assessmentData;

            return {
              ...p,
              name: data.profile?.fullName || p.name,
              age: data.profile?.age ?? p.age,
              gender: data.profile?.gender || p.gender,
              bloodType: (data.profile?.bloodGroup as string) || p.bloodType,
              phone: data.contact?.mobileNumber
                ? `${data.contact.countryCode} ${data.contact.mobileNumber}`
                : p.phone,
              emergencyContact: data.emergency?.contactName
                ? `${data.emergency.contactName} (${data.emergency.relationship}) - ${data.emergency.countryCode} ${data.emergency.contactNumber}`
                : p.emergencyContact,
              hasCompletedAssessment: markComplete ? true : p.hasCompletedAssessment,
              profileData: updatedProfile,
              contactData: updatedContact,
              emergencyData: updatedEmergency,
              assessmentData: updatedAssessment,
            };
          }),
        }));
      },

      requestPasswordReset: async (email: string) => {
        // Enforce uniform response time to mitigate account enumeration
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
        return {
          success: true,
          message:
            "If an account is associated with this email address, password recovery instructions and a secure reset link have been dispatched. Please check your inbox.",
        };
      },

      logout: () => {
        set({ currentPatientId: null });
      },

      registerPatient: (patientData) => {
        const newId = `PT-${Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000)}`;
        const newPatient: Patient = {
          ...patientData,
          id: newId,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        set((state) => ({
          patients: [newPatient, ...state.patients],
          currentPatientId: newId,
          records: {
            ...state.records,
            [newId]: [],
          },
        }));

        return newPatient;
      },

      updatePatientProfile: (patientId, updates) => {
        set((state) => ({
          patients: state.patients.map((p) =>
            p.id === patientId ? { ...p, ...updates } : p
          ),
        }));
      },

      addTestRecord: (patientId, recordData) => {
        const newRecord: TestRecord = {
          ...recordData,
          id: `REC-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}${Math.floor(Math.random() * 90 + 10)}`,
          patientId,
          timestamp: recordData.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        set((state) => {
          const currentList = state.records[patientId] || [];
          return {
            records: {
              ...state.records,
              [patientId]: [newRecord, ...currentList],
            },
          };
        });

        return newRecord;
      },

      deleteTestRecord: (patientId, recordId) => {
        set((state) => {
          const currentList = state.records[patientId] || [];
          return {
            records: {
              ...state.records,
              [patientId]: currentList.filter((r) => r.id !== recordId),
            },
          };
        });
      },

      switchPatient: (patientId) => {
        const found = get().patients.some((p) => p.id === patientId);
        if (found) {
          set({ currentPatientId: patientId });
        }
      },

      getCurrentPatient: () => {
        const { currentPatientId, patients } = get();
        if (!currentPatientId) return null;
        return patients.find((p) => p.id === currentPatientId) || null;
      },

      getPatientRecords: (patientId) => {
        return get().records[patientId] || [];
      },
    }),
    {
      name: "ear_to_heart_patients_v1",
    }
  )
);
````

````typescript
/**
 * Normalized sensor packet. Every field is optional on purpose:
 * a packet only carries what the firmware actually printed.
 * Missing field === no data. Never fill in a substitute value.
 */
export interface SensorPacket {
  timestamp?: number;
  ecg?: number;
  ecgLeadOff?: boolean;
  ppgIR?: number;
  ppgRed?: number;
  ppgWave?: number;
  bpm?: number;
  spo2?: number;
  signalQuality?: number;
  beat?: boolean;
  threshold?: number;
  /** LM35 body/skin temperature in degrees Celsius. */
  temperature?: number;
  /** BMI323 accelerometer, g. */
  accelX?: number;
  accelY?: number;
  accelZ?: number;
  /** BMI323 gyroscope, degrees per second. */
  gyroX?: number;
  gyroY?: number;
  gyroZ?: number;
}

export type PacketFormat = "json" | "csv" | "labeled" | "keyvalue" | "unknown";

export interface ParseResult {
  raw: string;
  format: PacketFormat;
  packet?: SensorPacket;
  error?: string;
}

export interface ValidationResult {
  ok: boolean;
  packet?: SensorPacket;
  errors: string[];
}

export type ConnectionState = "DISCONNECTED" | "CONNECTING" | "CONNECTED" | "ERROR";

export type DataState = "NO_DATA" | "RECEIVING" | "STALE";

export type TransportType = "serial" | "websocket";

export interface TransportEvents {
  onData: (line: string) => void;
  onError: (message: string) => void;
  onConnectionChange: (state: ConnectionState, detail?: string) => void;
}

export interface Transport {
  readonly type: TransportType;
  connect(): Promise<void>;
  disconnect(): Promise<void>;
  isConnected(): boolean;
  deviceName(): string | null;
}
````

````python
    3. PhysioNet MIT-BIH Authentic Single-Lead (Lead II) Beat-by-Beat Arrhythmia Classifier (AAMI 4-Class).
    4. SOTA Tabular Heart Failure Stacking Classifier (Trained on 918 Multicenter Real Patients).
    5. European 70,000-Patient Cardiovascular Disease Stacking Ensemble.

        }

        self.optimal_thresholds = {
            'NORM': 0.41,
            'MI': 0.35,
            'STTC': 0.45,
            'CD': 0.37,
            'HYP': 0.55
        }
        
        self.load_deep_learning_model()
        self.load_mitbih_arrhythmia_model()
        self.load_tabular_stacking_model()

    def load_deep_learning_model(self):
        base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
        native_single_lead_path = os.path.join(base_dir, '..', 'models', 'sota_single_lead_se_resnet_gru.pt')
        thresholds_path = os.path.join(base_dir, '..', 'models', 'single_lead_optimal_thresholds.json')
        sota_12lead_path = os.path.join(base_dir, '..', 'models', 'sota_se_resnet_gru.pt')

        if os.path.exists(native_single_lead_path):

                self.dl_model.eval()
                self.gradcam = ECG1DGradCAM(self.dl_model, self.dl_model.stage3)
                self.dl_model_type = "SOTA_Native_Single_Lead_SE_ResNet_GRU"
                self.is_native_single_lead = True
                print("[+] Loaded SOTA Native Single-Lead (Lead-II) SE-ResNet-1D + BiGRU model.")

                if isinstance(raw_feats, dict) and "optimal_features" in raw_feats:
                    self.tabular_features = raw_feats["optimal_features"]
                elif isinstance(raw_feats, list):
                    self.tabular_features = raw_feats
                else:
                    self.tabular_features = raw_feats.get("features", [])

                return

        models_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, '..', 'models')
        
        # 1. Cardio 70k
        c_mod = os.path.join(models_dir, 'cardio_70k_sota_ensemble.joblib')
        c_sc = os.path.join(models_dir, 'cardio_70k_scaler.joblib')
        c_ft = os.path.join(models_dir, 'cardio_70k_features.json')

                with open(c_ft, 'r') as f:
                    self.cardio_70k_features = json.load(f)
                print("[+] Loaded European 70,000-Patient Cardiovascular Disease Stacking Ensemble.")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[!] Cardio 70k load note: {e}")
                self.cardio_70k_model = None
        else:
            self.cardio_70k_model = None
            
        # 2. Framingham 10-Year CHD
        f_mod = os.path.join(models_dir, 'framingham_10yr_sota_ensemble.joblib')
        f_sc = os.path.join(models_dir, 'framingham_scaler.joblib')
        f_ft = os.path.join(models_dir, 'framingham_features.json')
        if os.path.exists(f_mod) and os.path.exists(f_sc):
            try:
                self.framingham_model = joblib.load(f_mod)
                self.framingham_scaler = joblib.load(f_sc)
                with open(f_ft, 'r') as f:
                    self.framingham_features = json.load(f)
                print("[+] Loaded Framingham Heart Study 10-Year Hard CHD Stacking Predictor.")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[!] Framingham load note: {e}")
                self.framingham_model = None
        else:
            self.framingham_model = None
            
        # 3. Stroke Risk
        s_mod = os.path.join(models_dir, 'stroke_sota_ensemble.joblib')
        s_sc = os.path.join(models_dir, 'stroke_scaler.joblib')
        s_ft = os.path.join(models_dir, 'stroke_features.json')
        if os.path.exists(s_mod) and os.path.exists(s_sc):
            try:
                self.stroke_model = joblib.load(s_mod)
                self.stroke_scaler = joblib.load(s_sc)
                with open(s_ft, 'r') as f:
                    self.stroke_features = json.load(f)
                print("[+] Loaded Cerebrovascular Stroke Clinical Stacking Classifier.")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[!] Stroke load note: {e}")
                self.stroke_model = None
        else:
            self.stroke_model = None

    def predict_ecg_sensor_stream(self, raw_waveform, ppg_data=None, reported_spo2=98.0, explain=True):
        sig = np.array(raw_waveform, dtype=np.float32)
        lead_to_evaluate = sig[0] if sig.ndim > 1 else sig
        
        sqi_report = self.sqi_engine.evaluate_sensor_signal(lead_to_evaluate, ppg_data, reported_spo2)
        if not sqi_report["can_proceed_to_ml"]:
            return {
                "status": "SIGNAL_QUALITY_REJECTED",
                "sqi_assessment": sqi_report,
                "message": sqi_report["message"],
                "detailed_analysis": []
            }
            
        if getattr(self, 'is_native_single_lead', True):
            if sig.ndim == 1:
                sig = sig.reshape(1, 1000)
            elif sig.shape[0] > 1:
                sig = sig[1:2, :]
        else:
            if sig.shape == (1, 1000) or len(sig.shape) == 1:
                sig = np.repeat(sig.reshape(1, 1000), 12, axis=0)
            
        mean = np.mean(sig, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        std = np.std(sig, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        std[std == 0] = 1e-6
        sig_norm = (sig - mean) / std
        
        tensor_sig = torch.tensor(sig_norm).unsqueeze(0).to(self.device)
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.dl_model(tensor_sig)
            probs = torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy()[0]
            
        primary_idx = int(np.argmax(probs))
        primary_condition = self.classes[primary_idx]
        
        attribution_map = []
        if explain and self.gradcam:
            try:
                heatmap = self.gradcam.generate_heatmap(tensor_sig, primary_idx)
                attribution_map = heatmap.tolist()
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[!] Grad-CAM note: {e}")
                
        results = []
        for i, cls_name in enumerate(self.classes):
            th = self.optimal_thresholds.get(cls_name, 0.50)
            is_detected = bool(probs[i] >= th)
            results.append({
                "class": cls_name,
                "description": self.class_descriptions[cls_name],
                "probability": float(probs[i]),
                "optimal_operating_threshold": float(th),
                "detected": is_detected
            })
            
        return {
            "status": "ANALYSIS_COMPLETE",
            "model_architecture": self.dl_model_type,
            "sqi_assessment": sqi_report,
            "primary_diagnosis": self.class_descriptions[primary_condition],
            "primary_confidence": float(probs[primary_idx]),
            "detailed_analysis": results,
            "gradcam_1d_attribution": attribution_map,
            "gradcam_attribution": attribution_map
        }

    def predict_lead2_arrhythmia_beat(self, beat_waveform):
        """
        Classifies an authentic single-lead Lead-II beat (180 samples) into AAMI categories:
        0: Normal Rhythm (N)
        1: Supraventricular Ectopic / PAC (S)
        2: Ventricular Ectopic / PVC (V)
        3: Fusion Beat (F)
        """
        if self.arrhythmia_net is None:
            return {"error": "MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Model not initialized."}
            
        sig = np.array(beat_waveform, dtype=np.float32)
        if len(sig) != 180:
            # Resample or pad/truncate to 180
            from scipy.signal import resample
            sig = resample(sig, 180).astype(np.float32)
            
        std = np.std(sig)
        if std > 1e-5:
            sig = (sig - np.mean(sig)) / std
            
        tensor_beat = torch.tensor(sig).view(1, 1, 180).to(self.device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = self.arrhythmia_net(tensor_beat)
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()[0]
            
        pred_idx = int(np.argmax(probs))
        
        return {
            "predicted_class": self.mitbih_classes[pred_idx],
            "confidence": round(float(probs[pred_idx]), 4),
            "is_arrhythmia": bool(pred_idx != 0),
            "critical_ventricular_warning": bool(pred_idx == 2),
            "class_probabilities": {
                "Normal": round(float(probs[0]), 4),
                "Supraventricular_PAC": round(float(probs[1]), 4),
                "Ventricular_PVC": round(float(probs[2]), 4),
                "Fusion": round(float(probs[3]), 4)
            }
        }

    def predict_tabular_vitals(self, patient_dict):
        if self.tabular_stacker is None:
            return {"error": "Tabular model not initialized."}
            
        df = pd.DataFrame([patient_dict])
        df_eng = engineer_clinical_features(df)
        
        for col, le in self.tabular_encoders.items():
            if col in df_eng.columns:
                val = df_eng[col].iloc[0]
                if val in le.classes_:
                    df_eng[col] = le.transform([val])[0]
                else:
                    df_eng[col] = 0
                    
        df_eng['ST_Chest_Interaction'] = df_eng['ST_Slope'] * df_eng['ChestPainType']
        X_sub = df_eng[self.tabular_features]
        X_scaled = self.tabular_scaler.transform(X_sub)
        
        prob = float(self.tabular_stacker.predict_proba(X_scaled)[:, 1][0])
        pred = int(prob >= 0.5)
        
        return {
            "heart_disease_risk_probability": round(prob, 4),
            "predicted_condition": "High Risk of Heart Disease" if pred == 1 else "Normal / Low Risk",
            "features_used": self.tabular_features
        }

    def predict_cardio_70k(self, patient_dict):
        """
        Runs SOTA Stacking Ensemble trained on 68,601 European Cardiovascular cohort patients.
        """
        if self.cardio_70k_model is None:
            return {"error": "Cardio 70k Model not loaded."}
            
        df = pd.DataFrame([patient_dict])
        age_yrs = float(patient_dict.get('age_years', patient_dict.get('age', 50.0)))
        hi = float(patient_dict.get('ap_hi', 120.0))
        lo = float(patient_dict.get('ap_lo', 80.0))
        h = float(patient_dict.get('height', 170.0))
        w = float(patient_dict.get('weight', 70.0))
        bmi = round(w / ((h / 100.0) ** 2), 2)
        
        pp = hi - lo
        map_val = lo + (pp / 3.0)
        bp_rat = hi / (lo + 1e-5)
        stiff = pp / (age_yrs + 1e-5)
        chol = float(patient_dict.get('cholesterol', 1))
        gluc = float(patient_dict.get('gluc', 1))
        ath = chol * gluc
        
        ob_stage = 0
        if bmi >= 35.0: ob_stage = 4
        elif bmi >= 30.0: ob_stage = 3
        elif bmi >= 25.0: ob_stage = 2
        elif bmi >= 18.5: ob_stage = 1
        
        ht_stage = 0
        if hi >= 180 or lo >= 120: ht_stage = 4
        elif hi >= 140 or lo >= 90: ht_stage = 3
        elif hi >= 130 or lo >= 80: ht_stage = 2
        elif hi >= 120: ht_stage = 1
        
        smk = float(patient_dict.get('smoke', 0))
        alc = float(patient_dict.get('alco', 0))
        act = float(patient_dict.get('active', 1))
        life_risk = smk * 1.5 + alc * 1.2 - act * 1.0
        
        row_dict = {
            'age_years': age_yrs,
            'gender': float(patient_dict.get('gender', 1)),
            'height': h,
            'weight': w,
            'bmi': bmi,
            'ap_hi': hi,
            'ap_lo': lo,
            'pulse_pressure': pp,
            'mean_arterial_pressure': map_val,
            'bp_ratio': bp_rat,
            'arterial_stiffness_index': stiff,
            'cholesterol': chol,
            'gluc': gluc,
            'atherogenic_risk': ath,
            'smoke': smk,
            'alco': alc,
            'active': act,
            'obesity_stage': float(ob_stage),
            'hypertension_stage': float(ht_stage),
            'cardiac_lifestyle_risk': life_risk
        }
        
        X_df = pd.DataFrame([row_dict])[self.cardio_70k_features]
        X_sc = self.cardio_70k_scaler.transform(X_df.values)
        prob = float(self.cardio_70k_model.predict_proba_raw(X_sc)[0])
        pred = int(prob >= getattr(self.cardio_70k_model, 'optimal_threshold', 0.50))
        
        return {
            "cardiovascular_disease_risk": round(prob, 4),
            "predicted_condition": "Cardiovascular Disease Positive" if pred == 1 else "Normal / Low Risk",
            "hemodynamic_metrics": {
                "pulse_pressure": round(pp, 1),
                "mean_arterial_pressure": round(map_val, 1),
                "hypertension_stage": ["Normal", "Elevated", "Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Hypertensive Crisis"][ht_stage],
                "bmi": bmi
            }
        }

    def predict_framingham_10yr(self, patient_dict):
        """
        Runs SOTA Stacking Predictor trained on Framingham 10-Year Hard CHD Cohort.
        """
        if self.framingham_model is None:
            return {"error": "Framingham Model not loaded."}
            
        sys_bp = float(patient_dict.get('sysBP', 120.0))
        dia_bp = float(patient_dict.get('diaBP', 80.0))
        pp = sys_bp - dia_bp
        map_val = dia_bp + (pp / 3.0)
        tot_chol = float(patient_dict.get('totChol', 200.0))
        age = float(patient_dict.get('age', 50.0))
        cur_smk = float(patient_dict.get('currentSmoker', 0))
        cigs = float(patient_dict.get('cigsPerDay', 0))
        diab = float(patient_dict.get('diabetes', 0))
        gluc = float(patient_dict.get('glucose', 85.0))
        bmi = float(patient_dict.get('BMI', 25.0))
        
        metabolic_score = int(sys_bp >= 130) + int(gluc >= 100) + int(bmi >= 30) + int(tot_chol >= 240)
        
        row_dict = {
            'male': float(patient_dict.get('male', 1)),
            'age': age,
            'education': float(patient_dict.get('education', 2)),
            'currentSmoker': cur_smk,
            'cigsPerDay': cigs,
            'smoke_intensity': cur_smk * cigs,
            'BPMeds': float(patient_dict.get('BPMeds', 0)),
            'prevalentStroke': float(patient_dict.get('prevalentStroke', 0)),
            'prevalentHyp': float(patient_dict.get('prevalentHyp', 0)),
            'diabetes': diab,
            'totChol': tot_chol,
            'sysBP': sys_bp,
            'diaBP': dia_bp,
            'pulse_pressure': pp,
            'mean_arterial_pressure': map_val,
            'atherogenic_pressure_index': (tot_chol * sys_bp) / 1000.0,
            'age_sys_interaction': (age * sys_bp) / 1000.0,
            'BMI': bmi,
            'heartRate': float(patient_dict.get('heartRate', 72.0)),
            'glucose': gluc,
            'diabetic_glucose_burden': diab * gluc,
            'metabolic_syndrome_score': float(metabolic_score)
        }
        
        X_df = pd.DataFrame([row_dict])[self.framingham_features]
        X_sc = self.framingham_scaler.transform(X_df.values)
        prob = float(self.framingham_model.predict_proba_raw(X_sc)[0])
        pred = int(prob >= getattr(self.framingham_model, 'optimal_threshold', 0.35))
        
        return {
            "ten_year_chd_risk_probability": round(prob, 4),
            "chd_risk_category": "Elevated 10-Year Coronary Risk" if pred == 1 else "Low 10-Year Risk",
            "metabolic_syndrome_score": metabolic_score
        }

    def predict_stroke_risk(self, patient_dict):
        """
        Runs SOTA Cerebrovascular Stacking Classifier (5,110 patients).
        """
        if self.stroke_model is None:
            return {"error": "Stroke Model not loaded."}
            
        gen_num = 1.0 if patient_dict.get('gender', 'Male') == 'Male' else 0.0
        marr_num = 1.0 if patient_dict.get('ever_married', 'Yes') == 'Yes' else 0.0
        urb_num = 1.0 if patient_dict.get('Residence_type', 'Urban') == 'Urban' else 0.0
        age = float(patient_dict.get('age', 55.0))
        hyp = float(patient_dict.get('hypertension', 0))
        hd = float(patient_dict.get('heart_disease', 0))
        glu = float(patient_dict.get('avg_glucose_level', 95.0))
        bmi = float(patient_dict.get('bmi', 26.0))
        
        cardioneuro_idx = (hyp * 2.0 + hd * 2.5) * (age / 50.0)
        metab_stroke = (glu * bmi) / 1000.0
        hi_risk = 1.0 if (age >= 60 and (hyp == 1 or hd == 1)) else 0.0
        
        wt = patient_dict.get('work_type', 'Private')
        smk = patient_dict.get('smoking_status', 'never smoked')
        
        row_dict = {
            'gender_num': gen_num,
            'age': age,
            'hypertension': hyp,
            'heart_disease': hd,
            'married_num': marr_num,
            'urban_num': urb_num,
            'avg_glucose_level': glu,
            'bmi': bmi,
            'cardioneuro_risk_index': cardioneuro_idx,
            'metabolic_stroke_index': metab_stroke,
            'high_risk_flag': hi_risk,
            'work_Never_worked': 1.0 if wt == 'Never_worked' else 0.0,
            'work_Private': 1.0 if wt == 'Private' else 0.0,
            'work_Self-employed': 1.0 if wt == 'Self-employed' else 0.0,
            'work_children': 1.0 if wt == 'children' else 0.0,
            'smoke_formerly smoked': 1.0 if smk == 'formerly smoked' else 0.0,
            'smoke_never smoked': 1.0 if smk == 'never smoked' else 0.0,
            'smoke_smokes': 1.0 if smk == 'smokes' else 0.0
        }
        
        for feat in self.stroke_features:
            if feat not in row_dict:
                row_dict[feat] = 0.0
                
        X_df = pd.DataFrame([row_dict])[self.stroke_features]
        X_sc = self.stroke_scaler.transform(X_df.values.astype(np.float32))
        prob = float(self.stroke_model.predict_proba_raw(X_sc)[0])
        pred = int(prob >= getattr(self.stroke_model, 'optimal_threshold', 0.25))
        
        return {
            "stroke_risk_probability": round(prob, 4),
            "predicted_condition": "Elevated Cerebrovascular Stroke Risk" if pred == 1 else "Normal / Low Risk",
            "cardioneuro_risk_index": round(cardioneuro_idx, 2)
        }
````

````python
)

)

except Exception as e:

class RawWaveformRequest(BaseModel):

    )

@app.post("/predict/ecg")
def predict_raw_ecg(req: RawWaveformRequest):
    if not cardiac_predictor:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Cardiac Predictor not loaded.")
    try:
        if len(req.signals) not in [1, 12]:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Must provide exactly 1 lead (AD8232) or 12 leads.")
        if len(req.signals[0]) != 1000:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Each lead must contain 1000 samples (10s @ 100Hz).")
            
        result = cardiac_predictor.predict_ecg_sensor_stream(
            raw_waveform=req.signals,
            ppg_data=req.ppg_signal,
            reported_spo2=req.reported_spo2 or 98.0
        )
        
        if conformal_guardrail and result.get("detailed_analysis"):
            probs = [c["probability"] for c in result["detailed_analysis"]]
            sqi = result.get("sqi_assessment", {}).get("overall_sqi", 0.95)
            conformal_report = conformal_guardrail.evaluate_with_guarantee(probs, sqi_score=sqi)
            result["conformal_uncertainty"] = conformal_report
            
        if history_service and result.get("status") == "ANALYSIS_COMPLETE":
            try:
                bpm_val = 72.0
                sqi_data = result.get("sqi_assessment")
                if isinstance(sqi_data, dict):
                    ppg_hrv = sqi_data.get("ppg_hrv_analysis")
                    if isinstance(ppg_hrv, dict) and ppg_hrv.get("heart_rate_bpm") is not None:
                        bpm_val = float(ppg_hrv.get("heart_rate_bpm"))

                hf_risk = 0.15
                if "detailed_analysis" in result:
                    for det in result["detailed_analysis"]:
                        if det.get("class") in ["STTC", "MI"]:
                            hf_risk = max(hf_risk, det.get("probability", 0.15))

                history_service.save_session({
                    "patient_id": req.patient_id or "default_patient",
                    "bpm": bpm_val,
                    "spo2": req.reported_spo2 or 98.0,
                    "primary_condition": result.get("primary_diagnosis"),
                    "confidence": result.get("primary_confidence"),
                    "heart_failure_risk": hf_risk,
                    "sqi_assessment": result.get("sqi_assessment", {}),
                    "conformal_certainty": result.get("conformal_uncertainty", {}).get("certainty_level")
                })
            except Exception as ex:
                print(f"[!] Background history sync note: {ex}")
                
        return result
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
````

````
/*
 * ================================================================
 * ESP32 MULTI-SENSOR HEALTH MONITOR
 * ACCURACY-FOCUSED VERSION + WIFI & WEBSOCKET SUPPORT
 * ================================================================
 *
 * MAX30102 -> Heart Rate + SpO2
 * AD8232   -> ECG
 * BMI323   -> Accelerometer + Gyroscope + Temperature
 * LM35     -> Temperature
 * SSD1306  -> OLED
 * WIFI/WS  -> WebSocket Server on Port 81
 *
 * I2C:
 * SDA -> GPIO 21
 * SCL -> GPIO 22
 *
 * AD8232:
 * OUTPUT -> GPIO 34
 * LO+    -> GPIO 32
 * LO-    -> GPIO 33
 *
 * LM35:
 * VOUT -> GPIO 35
 *
 * ================================================================
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 *
 * MAX30102 uses SparkFun/Maxim HR + SpO2 algorithm.
 *
 * Configuration:
 *
 * LED brightness = 60
 * Sample average = 4
 * LED mode       = RED + IR
 * Sample rate     = 100 Hz
 * Pulse width     = 411 us
 * ADC range       = 4096
 *
 * Effective sample rate for Maxim algorithm:
 * approximately 25 samples/sec.
 *
 * ================================================================
 */

#include <Wire.h>
#include <WiFi.h>

WebSocketsServer webSocket(81);

void webSocketEvent(
  uint8_t client,
  WStype_t type,
  uint8_t* payload,
  size_t length
)
{
  if (type == WStype_CONNECTED)
  {
    Serial.print("WebSocket client connected: #");
    Serial.println(client);
  }
  else if (type == WStype_DISCONNECTED)
  {
    Serial.print("WebSocket client disconnected: #");
    Serial.println(client);
  }
}

// ================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ================================================================

float clampFloat(
  float value,
  float minimum,
  float maximum
)
{
  if (value < minimum)
    return minimum;

  if (value > maximum)
    return maximum;

  return value;
}

// ================================================================
// MEDIAN BPM
// ================================================================

float getMedianBPM()
{
  float values[5];

  uint8_t count = 0;

  for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 5; i++)
  {
    if (bpmHistory[i] > 0)
    {
      values[count] =
        bpmHistory[i];

      count++;
    }
  }

  if (count == 0)
    return 0;

  // Sort

  for (uint8_t i = 0; i < count - 1; i++)
  {
    for (uint8_t j = i + 1; j < count; j++)
    {
      if (
        values[j] <
        values[i]
      )
      {
        float temp =
          values[i];

        values[i] =
          values[j];

        values[j] =
          temp;
      }
    }
  }

  return values[
    count / 2
  ];
}

// ================================================================
// MEDIAN SPO2
// ================================================================

float getMedianSpO2()
{
  float values[5];

  uint8_t count = 0;

  for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 5; i++)
  {
    if (
      spo2History[i] >= 70 &&
      spo2History[i] <= 100
    )
    {
      values[count] =
        spo2History[i];

      count++;
    }
  }

  if (count == 0)
    return 0;

  // Sort

  for (uint8_t i = 0; i < count - 1; i++)
  {
    for (uint8_t j = i + 1; j < count; j++)
    {
      if (
        values[j] <
        values[i]
      )
      {
        float temp =
          values[i];

        values[i] =
          values[j];

        values[j] =
          temp;
      }
    }
  }

  return values[
    count / 2
  ];
}

  for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 5; i++)
  {
    bpmHistory[i] = 0;

    spo2History[i] = 0;
  }

  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++)
  {
    irBuffer[i] = 0;

    redBuffer[i] = 0;
  }
}

// ================================================================
// INITIALIZE MAX30102
// ================================================================

bool initializeMAX30102()
{
  Serial.println();

  Serial.println(
    "Initializing MAX30102..."
  );

  if (
    !sensor.begin(
      Wire,
      I2C_SPEED_FAST
    )
  )
  {
    Serial.println(
      "MAX30102 NOT FOUND!"
    );

    return false;
  }

  Serial.println(
    "MAX30102 FOUND."
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // Reference configuration
  // ------------------------------------------------

  sensor.setup(
    LED_BRIGHTNESS,
    SAMPLE_AVERAGE,
    LED_MODE,
    SAMPLE_RATE,
    PULSE_WIDTH,
    ADC_RANGE
  );

  sensor.setPulseAmplitudeIR(
    LED_BRIGHTNESS
  );

  sensor.setPulseAmplitudeRed(
    LED_BRIGHTNESS
  );

  sensor.setPulseAmplitudeGreen(
    0
  );

  sensor.clearFIFO();

  resetMAXState();

  Serial.println(
    "MAX30102 configuration:"
  );

  Serial.print(
    "LED brightness: "
  );

  Serial.println(
    LED_BRIGHTNESS
  );

  Serial.print(
    "Sample average: "
  );

  Serial.println(
    SAMPLE_AVERAGE
  );

  Serial.print(
    "Sample rate: "
  );

  Serial.println(
    SAMPLE_RATE
  );

  Serial.println(
    "Effective rate: ~25 samples/sec"
  );

  return true;
}

// ================================================================
// PROCESS MAXIM HR + SPO2
// ================================================================

void processMAXAlgorithm()
{
  if (!fingerPresent)
    return;

  if (bufferIndex < BUFFER_SIZE)
    return;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // Run Maxim algorithm
  // ------------------------------------------------

  maxim_heart_rate_and_oxygen_saturation(
    irBuffer,
    BUFFER_SIZE,
    redBuffer,
    &algorithmSpO2,
    &algorithmSpO2Valid,
    &algorithmHR,
    &algorithmHRValid
  );

  // ==============================================================
  // HEART RATE
  // ==============================================================

  if (
    algorithmHRValid &&
    algorithmHR >= MIN_VALID_BPM &&
    algorithmHR <= MAX_VALID_BPM
  )
  {
    float newHR =
      (float)algorithmHR;

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // Reject sudden impossible jump
    // ------------------------------------------------

    if (
      bpm > 0 &&
      fabs(
        newHR - bpm
      ) > MAX_BPM_CHANGE
    )
    {
      Serial.print(
        "Rejected HR spike: "
      );

      Serial.println(
        newHR
      );
    }
    else
    {
      // ------------------------------------------------
      // Store valid HR
      // ------------------------------------------------

      bpmHistory[
        bpmHistoryIndex
      ] =
        newHR;

      bpmHistoryIndex++;

      if (
        bpmHistoryIndex >= 5
      )
      {
        bpmHistoryIndex = 0;
      }

      if (
        bpmHistoryCount < 5
      )
      {
        bpmHistoryCount++;
      }

      // ------------------------------------------------
      // Median filtering
      // ------------------------------------------------

      float medianHR =
        getMedianBPM();

      if (
        medianHR > 0
      )
      {
        if (
          bpm == 0
        )
        {
          bpm =
            medianHR;
        }
        else
        {
          /*
           * Slow smoothing.
           *
           * Prevents:
           *
           * 75 -> 126 -> 75
           *
           * from appearing on dashboard.
           */

          bpm =
            0.75f * bpm +
            0.25f * medianHR;
        }

        // Final safety limit

        bpm =
          clampFloat(
            bpm,
            MIN_VALID_BPM,
            MAX_VALID_BPM
          );
      }
    }
  }

  // ==============================================================
  // SpO2
  // ==============================================================

  if (
    algorithmSpO2Valid &&
    algorithmSpO2 >= 70 &&
    algorithmSpO2 <= 100
  )
  {
    float newSpO2 =
      (float)algorithmSpO2;

    // Store

    spo2History[
      spo2HistoryIndex
    ] =
      newSpO2;

    spo2HistoryIndex++;

    if (
      spo2HistoryIndex >= 5
    )
    {
      spo2HistoryIndex = 0;
    }

    if (
      spo2HistoryCount < 5
    )
    {
      spo2HistoryCount++;
    }

    // Median

    float medianSpO2 =
      getMedianSpO2();

    if (
      medianSpO2 > 0
    )
    {
      if (
        spo2 == 0
      )
      {
        spo2 =
          medianSpO2;
      }
      else
      {
        /*
         * SpO2 normally changes
         * slowly, so strong smoothing
         * is appropriate.
         */

        spo2 =
          0.85f * spo2 +
          0.15f * medianSpO2;
      }

      spo2 =
        clampFloat(
          spo2,
          70,
          100
        );
    }
  }
}

// ================================================================
// UPDATE MAX30102
// ================================================================

void updateMAX30102()
{
  if (!max30102Ready)
    return;

  /*
   * Check for new FIFO samples.
   *
   * IMPORTANT:
   * We do NOT return from the main loop
   * when there is no MAX30102 sample.
   */

  sensor.check();

  while (
    sensor.available()
  )
  {
    // ------------------------------------------------
    // CORRECT CHANNEL ASSIGNMENT
    // ------------------------------------------------

    uint32_t ir =
      sensor.getFIFOIR();

    uint32_t red =
      sensor.getFIFORed();

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // FINGER DETECTION
    // ------------------------------------------------

    if (
      ir < FINGER_THRESHOLD
    )
    {
      if (
        fingerPresent
      )
      {
        Serial.println(
          "Finger removed."
        );
      }

      resetMAXState();

      sensor.nextSample();

      continue;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // FINGER PRESENT
    // ------------------------------------------------

    if (
      !fingerPresent
    )
    {
      fingerPresent = true;

      Serial.println();

      Serial.println(
        "Finger detected."
      );

      Serial.println(
        "Collecting PPG samples..."
      );

      resetMAXState();

      fingerPresent = true;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // STORE SAMPLE
    // ------------------------------------------------

    if (
      bufferIndex < BUFFER_SIZE
    )
    {
      irBuffer[
        bufferIndex
      ] =
        ir;

      redBuffer[
        bufferIndex
      ] =
        red;

      bufferIndex++;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // FULL BUFFER
    // ------------------------------------------------

    if (
      bufferIndex >= BUFFER_SIZE
    )
    {
      processMAXAlgorithm();

      /*
       * Official algorithm uses:
       *
       * 75 old samples
       * +
       * 25 new samples
       *
       * giving approximately
       * one new calculation/sec.
       */

      for (
        uint16_t i = 25;
        i < BUFFER_SIZE;
        i++
      )
      {
        irBuffer[
          i - 25
        ] =
          irBuffer[i];

        redBuffer[
          i - 25
        ] =
          redBuffer[i];
      }

      bufferIndex = 75;
    }

    sensor.nextSample();
  }
}

// ================================================================
// ECG
// ================================================================

void updateECG()
{
  unsigned long now =
    micros();

  if (
    now -
    lastECGRead <
    ECG_INTERVAL_US
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  lastECGRead =
    now;

  bool loPlus =
    digitalRead(
      ECG_LO_PLUS
    );

  bool loMinus =
    digitalRead(
      ECG_LO_MINUS
    );

  if (
    loPlus ||
    loMinus
  )
  {
    ecgLeadsOff = true;

    ecgValue = 0;

    return;
  }

  ecgLeadsOff = false;

  ecgValue =
    analogRead(
      ECG_OUTPUT_PIN
    );
}

// ================================================================
// LM35
// ================================================================

void updateLM35()
{
  if (
    millis() -
    lastLM35Read <
    LM35_INTERVAL_MS
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  lastLM35Read =
    millis();

  /*
   * Average multiple ADC measurements
   * to reduce noise.
   */

  const uint8_t SAMPLE_COUNT = 16;

  uint32_t totalmV = 0;

  for (
    uint8_t i = 0;
    i < SAMPLE_COUNT;
    i++
  )
  {
    totalmV +=
      analogReadMilliVolts(
        LM35_PIN
      );
  }

  float averageVoltage =
    (float)totalmV /
    SAMPLE_COUNT;

  /*
   * LM35:
   *
   * 10 mV = 1°C
   */

  temperatureC =
    averageVoltage /
    10.0f;

  // Safety range

  if (
    temperatureC < -55 ||
    temperatureC > 150
  )
  {
    temperatureC = 0;
  }
}

// ================================================================
// BMI323
// ================================================================

void updateBMI323()
{
  if (!bmiReady)
    return;

  if (
    millis() -
    lastBMIRead <
    BMI_INTERVAL_MS
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  lastBMIRead =
    millis();

  bool accelOK =
    imu.readAccel(
      accelX,
      accelY,
      accelZ
    );

  bool gyroOK =
    imu.readGyro(
      gyroX,
      gyroY,
      gyroZ
    );

  if (
    !accelOK ||
    !gyroOK
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ACCELERATION MAGNITUDE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  accelMagnitude =
    sqrt(
      accelX * accelX +
      accelY * accelY +
      accelZ * accelZ
    );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // GYROSCOPE MAGNITUDE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  gyroMagnitude =
    sqrt(
      gyroX * gyroX +
      gyroY * gyroY +
      gyroZ * gyroZ
    );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // PITCH
  // ------------------------------------------------

  pitchDeg =
    atan2(
      accelX,
      sqrt(
        accelY * accelY +
        accelZ * accelZ
      )
    )
    * 180.0 /
    PI;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ROLL
  // ------------------------------------------------

  rollDeg =
    atan2(
      accelY,
      sqrt(
        accelX * accelX +
        accelZ * accelZ
      )
    )
    * 180.0 /
    PI;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BMI TEMPERATURE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  float temp;

  if (
    imu.getTemperature(temp)
  )
  {
    bmiTemperature =
      temp;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // MOTION HISTORY
  // ------------------------------------------------

  accelHistory[
    accelHistoryIndex
  ] =
    accelMagnitude;

  accelHistoryIndex++;

  if (
    accelHistoryIndex >=
    MOTION_HISTORY_SIZE
  )
  {
    accelHistoryIndex = 0;

    motionHistoryReady = true;
  }

  if (
    !motionHistoryReady
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // MEAN
  // ------------------------------------------------

  float mean = 0;

  for (
    uint8_t i = 0;
    i < MOTION_HISTORY_SIZE;
    i++
  )
  {
    mean +=
      accelHistory[i];
  }

  mean /=
    MOTION_HISTORY_SIZE;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // VARIANCE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  accelVariance = 0;

  for (
    uint8_t i = 0;
    i < MOTION_HISTORY_SIZE;
    i++
  )
  {
    float diff =
      accelHistory[i] -
      mean;

    accelVariance +=
      diff * diff;
  }

  accelVariance /=
    MOTION_HISTORY_SIZE;

  motionDetected =
    accelVariance > 0.02;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // MOTION STATE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  float gravityDeviation =
    fabs(
      accelMagnitude -
      1.0
    );

  if (
    gravityDeviation < 0.05 &&
    gyroMagnitude < 5.0
  )
  {
    motionState =
      "STABLE";
  }
  else if (
    gravityDeviation < 0.20 &&
    gyroMagnitude < 30.0
  )
  {
    motionState =
      "LIGHT";
  }
  else
  {
    motionState =
      "ACTIVE";
  }
}

// ================================================================
// DRAW HEART
// ================================================================

void drawHeart(
  int16_t x,
  int16_t y
)
{
  display.fillCircle(
    x + 3,
    y + 3,
    3,
    SSD1306_WHITE
  );

  display.fillCircle(
    x + 9,
    y + 3,
    3,
    SSD1306_WHITE
  );

  display.fillTriangle(
    x,
    y + 4,
    x + 12,
    y + 4,
    x + 6,
    y + 11,
    SSD1306_WHITE
  );
}

// ================================================================
// OLED HEART PAGE
// ================================================================

void renderHeartPage()
{
  display.clearDisplay();

  display.setTextColor(
    SSD1306_WHITE
  );

  display.setTextWrap(false);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // TITLE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  display.setTextSize(1);

  display.setCursor(
    0,
    0
  );

  display.print(
    "HEART MONITOR"
  );

  display.setCursor(
    105,
    0
  );

  display.print(
    "1/2"
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // LABELS
  // ------------------------------------------------

  display.setTextSize(2);

  display.setCursor(
    0,
    12
  );

  display.print(
    "BPM"
  );

  display.setCursor(
    72,
    12
  );

  display.print(
    "SpO2"
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BPM
  // ------------------------------------------------

  display.setTextSize(3);

  display.setCursor(
    0,
    32
  );

  if (
    fingerPresent &&
    bpm >= MIN_VALID_BPM &&
    bpm <= MAX_VALID_BPM
  )
  {
    display.print(
      (int)round(bpm)
    );
  }
  else
  {
    display.print(
      "--"
    );
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // SPO2
  // ------------------------------------------------

  display.setCursor(
    72,
    32
  );

  if (
    fingerPresent &&
    spo2 >= 70 &&
    spo2 <= 100
  )
  {
    display.print(
      (int)round(spo2)
    );

    display.setTextSize(1);

    display.setCursor(
      116,
      35
    );

    display.print(
      "%"
    );
  }
  else
  {
    display.print(
      "--"
    );
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // HEART ANIMATION
  // ------------------------------------------------

  if (
    millis() <
    heartBeatTimer
  )
  {
    drawHeart(
      48,
      52
    );
  }

  display.display();
}

// ================================================================
// OLED UPDATE
// ================================================================

void updateDisplay()
{
  if (
    millis() -
    lastPageChange >=
    PAGE_INTERVAL_MS
  )
  {
    currentPage++;

    if (
      currentPage >=
      TOTAL_PAGES
    )
    {
      currentPage = 0;
    }

    lastPageChange =
      millis();
  }

  if (
    millis() -
    lastDisplayUpdate <
    DISPLAY_INTERVAL_MS
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  lastDisplayUpdate =
    millis();

  if (
    currentPage ==
    PAGE_HEART
  )
  {
    renderHeartPage();
  }
  else
  {
    renderBMIPage();
  }
}

// ================================================================
// SERIAL & WEBSOCKET DASHBOARD PACKET
// ================================================================

void sendDashboardPacket()
{
  if (
    millis() -
    lastSerialSend <
    SERIAL_INTERVAL_MS
  )
  {
    return;
  }

  lastSerialSend =
    millis();

  String packet = "";
  packet.reserve(256);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ECG
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += "ECG:";
  packet += String(ecgValue);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // PPG IR
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", IR_Signal:";
  if (bufferIndex > 0)
  {
    packet += String(irBuffer[bufferIndex - 1]);
  }
  else
  {
    packet += "0";
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // PPG RED
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", Red_Signal:";
  if (bufferIndex > 0)
  {
    packet += String(redBuffer[bufferIndex - 1]);
  }
  else
  {
    packet += "0";
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // FINGER
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", Finger:";
  packet += (fingerPresent ? "1" : "0");

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // RAW HR FROM MAXIM
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", HR_Raw:";
  packet += String(algorithmHR);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // HR VALID
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", HR_Valid:";
  packet += String(algorithmHRValid);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // FILTERED BPM
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", BPM:";
  if (fingerPresent && bpm >= MIN_VALID_BPM && bpm <= MAX_VALID_BPM)
  {
    packet += String(bpm, 1);
  }
  else
  {
    packet += "0";
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // RAW SPO2
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", SpO2_Raw:";
  packet += String(algorithmSpO2);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // SPO2 VALID
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", SpO2_Valid:";
  packet += String(algorithmSpO2Valid);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // FILTERED SPO2
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", SpO2:";
  if (fingerPresent && spo2 >= 70 && spo2 <= 100)
  {
    packet += String(spo2, 1);
  }
  else
  {
    packet += "0";
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BMI ACCELEROMETER
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", BMI_AX:";
  packet += String(accelX, 2);
  packet += ", BMI_AY:";
  packet += String(accelY, 2);
  packet += ", BMI_AZ:";
  packet += String(accelZ, 2);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BMI GYROSCOPE
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", BMI_GX:";
  packet += String(gyroX, 1);
  packet += ", BMI_GY:";
  packet += String(gyroY, 1);
  packet += ", BMI_GZ:";
  packet += String(gyroZ, 1);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ACCEL MAGNITUDE
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", AccMag:";
  packet += String(accelMagnitude, 2);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // LM35
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", LM35:";
  packet += String(temperatureC, 1);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BMI TEMPERATURE
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", BMI_Temp:";
  packet += String(bmiTemperature, 1);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // MOTION
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", Motion:";
  packet += motionState;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ECG LEADS
  // ------------------------------------------------
  packet += ", LeadsOff:";
  packet += (ecgLeadsOff ? "1" : "0");

  // Output to Serial Monitor / Web Serial
  Serial.println(packet);

  // Broadcast over WebSocket if WiFi is connected
  if (ENABLE_WIFI && WiFi.status() == WL_CONNECTED)
  {
    webSocket.broadcastTXT(packet);
  }
}

// ================================================================
// I2C SCANNER
// ================================================================

void scanI2C()
{
  Serial.println();

  Serial.println(
    "================ I2C SCANNER ================"
  );

  uint8_t found = 0;

  for (
    uint8_t address = 1;
    address < 127;
    address++
  )
  {
    Wire.beginTransmission(
      address
    );

    if (
      Wire.endTransmission() ==
      0
    )
    {
      Serial.print(
        "I2C device found at 0x"
      );

      if (
        address < 16
      )
      {
        Serial.print(
          "0"
        );
      }

      Serial.println(
        address,
        HEX
      );

      found++;
    }
  }

  if (
    found == 0
  )
  {
    Serial.println(
      "No I2C devices found!"
    );
  }

  Serial.println(
    "=============================================="
  );
}

// ================================================================
// BMI323 INITIALIZATION
// ================================================================

void setupBMI323()
{
  Serial.println();

  Serial.println(
    "Initializing BMI323..."
  );

  if (
    imu.beginI2C(
      BMI323_ADDRESS_68
    )
  )
  {
    bmiReady = true;

    bmiAddress =
      BMI323_ADDRESS_68;

    Serial.println(
      "BMI323 FOUND at 0x68"
    );

    return;
  }

  if (
    imu.beginI2C(
      BMI323_ADDRESS_69
    )
  )
  {
    bmiReady = true;

    bmiAddress =
      BMI323_ADDRESS_69;

    Serial.println(
      "BMI323 FOUND at 0x69"
    );

    return;
  }

  bmiReady = false;

  Serial.println(
    "BMI323 NOT FOUND!"
  );
}

// ================================================================
// SETUP
// ================================================================

void setup()
{
  Serial.begin(
    115200
  );

  delay(300);

  Serial.println();

  Serial.println(
    "=========================================="
  );

  Serial.println(
    " ESP32 HEALTH MONITOR"
  );

  Serial.println(
    " ACCURACY-FOCUSED VERSION"
  );

  Serial.println(
    " MAX30102 + AD8232 + BMI323 + LM35"
  );

  Serial.println(
    "=========================================="
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ECG
  // ------------------------------------------------

  pinMode(
    ECG_LO_PLUS,
    INPUT
  );

  pinMode(
    ECG_LO_MINUS,
    INPUT
  );

  pinMode(
    ECG_OUTPUT_PIN,
    INPUT
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // LM35
  // ------------------------------------------------

  pinMode(
    LM35_PIN,
    INPUT
  );

  analogReadResolution(
    12
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // I2C
  // ------------------------------------------------

  Wire.begin(
    I2C_SDA,
    I2C_SCL
  );

  Wire.setClock(
    400000
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // I2C SCAN
  // ------------------------------------------------

  scanI2C();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // OLED
  // ------------------------------------------------

  Serial.println(
    "Initializing OLED..."
  );

  if (
    !display.begin(
      SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC,
      SCREEN_ADDRESS
    )
  )
  {
    Serial.println(
      "SSD1306 allocation failed!"
    );

    while (1)
    {
      delay(10);
    }
  }

  display.clearDisplay();

  display.setTextColor(
    SSD1306_WHITE
  );

  display.setTextSize(1);

  display.setCursor(
    10,
    20
  );

  display.println(
    "Health Monitor"
  );

  display.setCursor(
    10,
    35
  );

  display.println(
    "Starting..."
  );

  display.display();

  delay(500);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BMI323
  // ------------------------------------------------

  setupBMI323();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // MAX30102
  // ------------------------------------------------

  max30102Ready =
    initializeMAX30102();

  if (
    !max30102Ready
  )
  {
    display.clearDisplay();

    display.setTextSize(2);

    display.setCursor(
      0,
      10
    );

    display.println(
      "MAX30102"
    );

    display.println(
      "ERROR!"
    );

    display.display();

    while (1)
    {
      updateECG();

      updateBMI323();

      updateLM35();

      delay(1);
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // INITIALIZE MOTION HISTORY
  // ------------------------------------------------

  for (
    uint8_t i = 0;
    i < MOTION_HISTORY_SIZE;
    i++
  )
  {
    accelHistory[i] =
      1.0;
  }

  motionHistoryReady =
    false;

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // WIFI & WEBSOCKET SETUP
  // ------------------------------------------------

  if (ENABLE_WIFI)
  {
    WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
    WiFi.begin(WIFI_SSID, WIFI_PASSWORD);

    Serial.println();
    Serial.print("WiFi connecting to: ");
    Serial.println(WIFI_SSID);

    unsigned long start = millis();
    while (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED && millis() - start < 10000)
    {
      delay(300);
      Serial.print(".");
    }
    Serial.println();

    if (WiFi.status() == WL_CONNECTED)
    {
      Serial.print("WiFi Connected! IP: ");
      Serial.println(WiFi.localIP());

      Serial.print("WebSocket: ws://");
      Serial.print(WiFi.localIP());
      Serial.println(":81");

      webSocket.begin();
      webSocket.onEvent(webSocketEvent);
    }
    else
    {
      Serial.println("WiFi connection FAILED / TIMED OUT");
      Serial.println("Running USB Serial only.");
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // TIMERS
  // ------------------------------------------------

  lastECGRead =
    micros();

  lastBMIRead =
    millis();

  lastLM35Read =
    millis();

  lastSerialSend =
    millis();

  lastDisplayUpdate =
    millis();

  lastPageChange =
    millis();

  Serial.println();

  Serial.println(
    "=========================================="
  );

  Serial.println(
    "SYSTEM READY"
  );

  Serial.println(
    "Place finger on MAX30102."
  );

  Serial.println(
    "Keep finger steady."
  );

  Serial.println(
    "Initial HR/SpO2 calculation takes ~4 sec."
  );

  Serial.println(
    "=========================================="
  );
}

// ================================================================
// MAIN LOOP
// ================================================================

void loop()
{
  // ------------------------------------------------
  // WEBSOCKET SERVICE
  // ------------------------------------------------

  if (
    ENABLE_WIFI &&
    WiFi.status() ==
    WL_CONNECTED
  )
  {
    webSocket.loop();
  }

  /*
   * IMPORTANT:
   *
   * There is NO blocking MAX30102 loop here.
   *
   * Every sensor gets CPU time independently.
   */

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // ECG
  // ------------------------------------------------

  updateECG();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // MAX30102
  // ------------------------------------------------

  updateMAX30102();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // BMI323
  // ------------------------------------------------

  updateBMI323();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // LM35
  // ------------------------------------------------

  updateLM35();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // OLED
  // ------------------------------------------------

  updateDisplay();

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // DASHBOARD
  // ------------------------------------------------

  sendDashboardPacket();
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

  low: "ok",

  elevated: "warn",
  high: "error",
};

  low: "bg-status-ok",
  moderate: "bg-status-warn",
  elevated: "bg-status-warn",
  high: "bg-destructive",
};

function num(value: number | null, digits = 0, unit = "") {
  return value === null || !Number.isFinite(value) ? "--" : `${value.toFixed(digits)}${unit}`;
}

interface DLAnalysisResult {
  isOfflineFallback?: boolean;
  model_architecture?: string;
  primary_diagnosis: string;
  confidence: number;
  detailed_analysis: {
    class: string;
    description: string;
    probability: number;
    optimal_operating_threshold?: number;
    detected?: boolean;
  }[];
  sqi_assessment?: {
    overall_sqi: number;
    decision: string;
    message: string;
  };
}

export function RiskPanel() {
  const connectionState = useSensorStore((s) => s.connectionState);
  const ecgSamples = useSensorStore((s) => s.ecgSamples);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  const [dlAnalysis, setDlAnalysis] = useState<DLAnalysisResult | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(async () => {
      setTick((n) => n + 1);

      const ecgValues = buffers.ecg.toArray();
      if (ecgValues.length > 500) {
        let padded = ecgValues.slice(-1000);
        if (padded.length < 1000) {
          padded = [...new Array(1000 - padded.length).fill(0), ...padded];
        }

        try {
          const currentPatient = usePatientStore.getState().getCurrentPatient();
          const liveSpo2 = useSensorStore.getState().spo2;

          const res = await fetch("http://localhost:8000/predict/ecg", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              signals: [padded],
              patient_id: currentPatient?.id || "PT-10492",
              reported_spo2: liveSpo2 || 98.0,
            }),
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            const data = await res.json();
            setDlAnalysis(data);
            useSensorStore.getState().setAiDiagnosisResult(data);
          } else {
            // Client-side Edge Offline Fallback
            const fallback = runEdgeOfflineDiagnostics(padded);
            setDlAnalysis(fallback);
            useSensorStore.getState().setAiDiagnosisResult(fallback);

        } catch {
          // Client-side Edge Offline Fallback if server unreachable
          const fallback = runEdgeOfflineDiagnostics(padded);
          setDlAnalysis(fallback);
          useSensorStore.getState().setAiDiagnosisResult(fallback);

    return () => window.clearInterval(id);

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">Extracted signal features (real measurements)</h2>
        <dl className="mt-3 grid gap-x-6 gap-y-2 font-mono text-xs sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {[
            ["Analysis window", `${analysis.windowSeconds.toFixed(1)} s`],
            ["ECG sampling", num(ecg.samplingHz, 0, " Hz")],
            ["Detected beats", String(ecg.beatCount)],
            ["ECG heart rate", num(ecg.heartRate, 0, " bpm")],
            ["SDNN", num(ecg.sdnn, 0, " ms")],
            ["RMSSD", num(ecg.rmssd, 0, " ms")],
            ["pNN50", ecg.pnn50 === null ? "--" : `${(ecg.pnn50 * 100).toFixed(0)} %`],
            [
              "RR irregularity",
              ecg.irregularity === null ? "--" : `${(ecg.irregularity * 100).toFixed(0)} %`,
            ],
            ["QRS amplitude", num(ecg.qrsAmplitude, 0, " counts")],
            ["QRS duration", num(ecg.qrsDuration, 0, " ms")],
            [
              "ST deviation",
              ecg.stDeviation === null ? "--" : `${(ecg.stDeviation * 100).toFixed(1)} % of R`,
            ],
            ["QT Interval", num(ecg.qtIntervalMs, 0, " ms")],
            ["QTc (Bazett)", num(ecg.qtcBazettMs, 0, " ms")],
            ["QTc (Fridericia)", num(ecg.qtcFridericiaMs, 0, " ms")],
            ["PR Interval", num(ecg.prIntervalMs, 0, " ms")],
            ["Baevsky Stress Index", num(ecg.stressIndex, 1, " SI")],
            ["Mean SpO₂", num(analysis.spo2.mean, 1, " %")],
            ["Mean BPM (firmware)", num(analysis.bpm.mean, 0, " bpm")],
            ["Mean temperature", num(analysis.temperature.mean, 1, " °C")],
            ["Motion (|a|)", num(analysis.motion.mean, 2, " g")],
            [
              "Subject state",
              analysis.motion.count === 0 ? "--" : analysis.restingLikely ? "AT REST" : "MOVING",
            ],
          ].map(([label, value]) => (
            <div key={label} className="flex justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border/60 py-1">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
              <dd className="tabular-nums">{value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">How this estimate is produced</h2>
        <ul className="mt-2 list-disc space-y-1 pl-5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <li>
            R peaks are detected with a Pan-Tompkins style pipeline (derivative → squaring → 120 ms
            integration → adaptive threshold) on the raw AD8232 stream.
          </li>
          <li>
            Each condition uses an interpretable logistic model over those features. Weights come
            from published clinical thresholds — ST deviation for ischemia, QRS low voltage for
            amyloidosis, QRS widening and RR irregularity for fibrosis, resting tachycardia with
            desaturation for heart failure.
          </li>
          <li>
            A feature that has not been measured is reported as missing and simply left out of the
            score — it is never replaced by an assumed value.
          </li>
          <li>
            Single-lead ECG plus PPG cannot diagnose these diseases. Treat every percentage as a
            screening signal for follow-up with a clinician, not a diagnosis.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useSensorStore } from "@/store/sensorStore";

function useAge(time: number | null) {
  const [, tick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = window.setInterval(() => tick((n) => n + 1), 250);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, []);
  return time === null ? null : Date.now() - time;
}

/* Animated signal strength bars */
function SignalBars({ active }: { active: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-end gap-[3px] h-5" aria-hidden>
      {[3, 5, 7, 9].map((h, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          style={{ height: `${h * 2}px`, transitionDelay: `${i * 60}ms` }}
          className={cn(
            "w-1.5 rounded-sm transition-all duration-500",
            active ? "bg-status-ok" : i === 0 ? "bg-muted-foreground/40" : "bg-muted-foreground/15",
          )}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ConnectionBar() {
  const state = useSensorStore();
  const age = useAge(state.lastPacketTime);
  const [supported, setSupported] = useState(true);

  const receiving = connected && state.dataState === "RECEIVING" && (age ?? 9999) < 2000;

  const linkTone: PillTone =
    state.connectionState === "CONNECTED"
      ? "ok"
      : state.connectionState === "ERROR"
        ? "error"
        : "idle";

  const dataTone: PillTone = receiving ? "ok" : connected ? "warn" : "idle";

    <section
      aria-label="Connection status"
      className={cn(
        "rounded-2xl border p-5 transition-all duration-300",
        "bg-card hover:shadow-lg",
        connected && receiving && "border-status-ok/25 shadow-status-ok/5",

      )}
    >

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Left: signal bars + status pills + connection metadata */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-3">
          {/* Signal indicator */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <SignalBars active={receiving} />
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-widest text-muted-foreground uppercase mb-1">
````

````typescript
    if (liveTemperature && liveTemperature > 30) setRecordTemp(Number(liveTemperature.toFixed(1)));
    setRecordNotes((prev) =>
      prev ? `${prev} (Auto-synced from live ESP32 hardware session)` : "Auto-synced from live ESP32 hardware session"
    );
  };

  const handleCreateRecord = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    addTestRecord(currentPatient.id, {
      testType: recordTestType,
      bpm: Number(recordBpm),
      spo2: Number(recordSpo2),
      temperature: Number(recordTemp),
      bloodPressure: recordBP,
      ecgStatus: recordEcgStatus,
      aiRiskLevel: recordRiskLevel,
      aiDiagnosis: recordAiDiagnosis,
      notes: recordNotes,
      device: "ESP32 Ear-to-Heart Biosensor v2.0",
    });

    toast.success("New test record logged.");
    setIsAddingRecord(false);
    setRecordNotes("");
  };

  const assessment = currentPatient.assessmentData;
  const emergency = currentPatient.emergencyData;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 space-y-8 animate-fade-in">

        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-1/3 -mb-16 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-primary/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-6">
          {/* Avatar and Info */}

            <div className="flex h-20 w-20 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-500 to-amber-500 text-3xl font-black text-white shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/30">
              {currentPatient.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                  {currentPatient.name}
                </h1>
                <span className="rounded-full border border-orange-500/30 bg-orange-500/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-orange-500">
                  {currentPatient.id}
                </span>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  {currentPatient.gender}
                </span>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  Age: <strong className="text-foreground">{currentPatient.age}</strong>
                </span>
                {currentPatient.bloodType && (
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                    Blood: {currentPatient.bloodType}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Condition: <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{currentPatient.condition || "Routine Telemetry"}</span>
                {currentPatient.email && <> • {currentPatient.email}</>}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveSubgroup("advanced")}

                activeSubgroup === "advanced"
                  ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-primary/20"
                  : "border border-orange-500/40 bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 hover:bg-orange-500/20"
              }`}
            >
              <Heart className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Advanced Monitoring</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleOpenEdit}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border/80 bg-background/80 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground shadow-sm hover:bg-accent hover:border-border transition-all"
            >
              <Edit3 className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-500" />
              <span>Edit Details (Name, Age, Gender)</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => setIsAddingRecord(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-500 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/25 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-600 active:scale-95 transition-all"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Record New Test</span>
            </button>

            {/* Switch patient dropdown */}
            <div className="relative group">
              <select
                value={currentPatient.id}
                onChange={(e) => switchPatient(e.target.value)}
                className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-border/80 bg-background/80 px-3 pr-8 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20"
                aria-label="Switch Patient"
              >
                {patients.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    Switch: {p.name} ({p.id})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => {
                logout();
                navigate({ to: "/login" });
              }}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20 transition-all"
              title="Sign Out"
            >
              <LogOut className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Logout</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Vitals Summary Cards */}
        <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 border-t border-border/60 pt-6">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-background/50 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Total Tests</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{records.length}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">Stored in patient record</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-background/50 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Mean Heart Rate</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-rose-500">
              {records.length > 0
                ? Math.round(records.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.bpm, 0) / records.length)
                : "--"}{" "}
              <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">BPM</span>
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">Across clinical sessions</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-background/50 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Mean SpO₂</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-sky-500">
              {records.length > 0
                ? (records.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.spo2, 0) / records.length).toFixed(1)
                : "--"}
              %
            </p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">Blood oxygen saturation</p>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-background/50 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Live Hardware</p>
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${connectionState === "CONNECTED" ? "bg-emerald-500 animate-ping" : "bg-slate-400"}`} />
              <p className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                {liveBpm ? `${Math.round(liveBpm)} BPM` : connectionState === "CONNECTED" ? "Receiving" : "Standby"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Link
````
